rationale: Descends a separator hierarchy so chunks break on paragraphs and sentences rather than mid-clause.
Fixed geometry plus a title/section prefix on the embedded text only, restoring referents that bare passages lose.
Overlay that prepends a situating blurb (title + lead) to each chunk before embedding, without altering cited text.
Control. Fixed 120-word windows, 24-word overlap. The naive split every other strategy is measured against.
Boundaries placed at per-document similarity percentiles, so cuts land where the topic actually changes.
Retrieve small, read big: indexes one sentence, serves a 7-sentence window to the generator.
Weighted sum of min-max normalised scores: keeps within-run margins, but one outlier rescales the whole run.
Weighted sum of z-scored runs: margin-preserving and outlier-tolerant, assumes roughly symmetric score distributions.
Reciprocal Rank Fusion: rank-only, so a run with an uncalibrated score scale cannot dominate.
Control: BM25 only. Isolates what the dense run contributes.
Control: HNSW only. Isolates what the sparse run contributes.
